_description: Anchored-spoke registry: the source of truth mapping Claude Code launch directories (cwd anchors) to stable spoke keys. The plan-creation skills (new-plan, backlog-research / promote-from-inbox) resolve the session cwd through this registry to stamp the manifest `project:` field — the owning-spoke machine identity. The spoke key is NEVER the bare directory basename; it is the registry-resolved key. Plans launched from the home anchor resolve to the literal `home` catch-all. Adopters add a spoke entry per project they launch Claude Code from.

_design_notes.resolution: A spoke key is resolved by matching the session cwd against each entry's `cwd_anchors[]` (longest-anchor-wins). No match resolves to the `home` catch-all. Two distinct cwd anchors MUST NOT resolve to the same spoke key — a collision blocks plan creation with a diagnostic naming both anchors and the shared key (collision-safe resolver).
_design_notes.override: Plan creation accepts a `--project <spoke-key>` override for a deliberate cross-project continuation; the value MUST resolve to an existing entry below, else creation blocks listing the valid keys (no silent fallback).
_design_notes.binder_home: Each spoke key keys a project binder at ~/.claude-plans/_projects/<spoke-key>/.

spokes.description: Home catch-all. Plans launched from the home directory (no project anchor) resolve here.
